Preterm subjects mapped onto the perinatal trajectory of gyrification.  We show that the neurodevelopment of gyrification as a function of age for preterm participants ( n  = 102) follows a continuous trajectory compared to a jump seen around birth in our typically developing population ( n  = 819).
